# JM Masala Trading LLP

> JM Masala Trading LLP is an Indian spice manufacturer, processor and exporter based in the APMC Market Yard, Unjha, Gujarat. We supply whole seeds and powders in bulk to international buyers, with private label packing available.

Last updated: 2026-10

## Company
- Legal name: JM Masala Trading LLP (brand: JM Masala)
- Address: A/18, Main Line, APMC Market Yard, Unjha, Mehsana District, Gujarat 384170, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 91067 66041, +91 98245 10478
- Email: jmmasalaexports@gmail.com
- Website: https://jmmasalaexports.com

## What we do
- Whole spice seeds and spice powders for export and bulk supply
- Processing: cleaning and Sortex colour sorting
- Bulk packing in 25 kg and 50 kg PP bags; private label packing on request
- Shipping basis: FOB Mundra
- Product specifications and minimum order quantities are provided on request with a quotation. Please contact us for samples and prices.
